crop_gesture_fix.issue: Vertical crop handle resizing previously allowed parent ScrollView to steal touches and scroll the page.

resolution.parent_scroll_lock: Connected onInteractionStart and onInteractionEnd callbacks from GarmentRegionSelector to AddGarmentScreen isParentScrollEnabled state, locking parent ScrollView during all crop adjustments.
resolution.edge_pan_responders: Implemented dedicated edge PanResponders for top, bottom, left, and right handles with onStartShouldSetPanResponderCapture and onMoveShouldSetPanResponderCapture returning true.
resolution.termination_protection: Configured onPanResponderTerminationRequest: () => false and onShouldBlockNativeResponder: () => true across all 9 PanResponders (center, 4 corners, 4 edges).
resolution.touch_targets: Maintained 52x52 touch target slop (HANDLE_TOUCH_SLOP = 16px, min touch target 56px).
resolution.viewport_stability: Image viewport remains strictly stationary while crop coordinates update accurately.
resolution.normalized_space_preservation: All coordinates remain normalized [0..1] with 5% crop padding and aspect-fit pillar/letterbox compensation preserved.

test_coverage: top handle dragged downward (clamped to min dimension)
bottom handle dragged upward (clamped to min dimension)
selection rectangle moved vertically and horizontally without changing dimensions
parent scroll lock lifecycle simulation (disabled on touch, restored on release)

mix_match_ux_rework.mental_model_shift: Replaced inventory database / category card layout (TOP / BOTTOM / SHOES cards with individual swap buttons) with an Editorial Stylist model: Wardrobe -> AURA styles a complete look -> User refines the look.

primary_screen_hierarchy.hero_centerpiece: Complete Outfit Flat-Lay (EditorialOutfitCanvas) displaying Top, Bottom, Footwear naturally proportioned with realistic overlap, zero rectangular inventory cards, and optional outerwear/accessory framing.
primary_screen_hierarchy.look_identity: LOOK 01 • EDITORIAL MINIMAL (Clean archetype labeling without technical database identifiers).
primary_screen_hierarchy.why_this_works: Editorial qualitative explanation grounded in color harmony and volume balance. Arbitrary numerical scores (e.g. 94/100, 98% match) strictly eliminated.
primary_screen_hierarchy.action_pair: Prominent [Swap a piece] (secondary outline) and [Save Look] (primary solid black) buttons.
primary_screen_hierarchy.alternate_looks: Horizontal look selector (LOOK 01, LOOK 02, LOOK 03) allowing immediate exploration of alternative complete styling archetypes.

whering_inspired_principles_used: Visual wardrobe: user's authentic clothing photos dominate the entire screen
Image-first browsing: closet browsing drawer features clean image gallery with minimal metadata chrome
Complete outfit composition: outfit displayed as an integrated styling composition rather than segregated cards
Effortless piece replacement: tapping any item on the canvas or tapping [Swap a piece] opens the closet drawer for instant swap
Minimal technical metadata: eliminated AI confidence chips, category IDs, and database tags from primary UI
aura_specific_design_retained: Warm cream (#F9F9F8) and crisp white (#FFFFFF) background surfaces
Context-aware occasion/weather styling intelligence (only when genuine)
Integration with personal Studio / Virtual Try-On flow
